summary: Supplies the visual style source for direct Stability style transfer. Lixpi derives it from the second resolved image reference; it is an attachment role, not a dropdown or scalar model option.
combines: Direct style transfer requires init_image for subject and composition plus style_image for palette, texture, and rendering style.
style_strength controls its influence and Lixpi fixes that value at 1.
The current Bedrock Ultra and SD3.5 route accepts only one image, so it drops the second style reference instead of sending style_image.
range: every side at least 64 px, total pixels at most 9,437,184, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1
note: Populated internally from the second provider-neutral reference; not shown as a model configuration control.

usage.from: the second resolved image reference on a two-reference direct request
usage.what: Provides the style source for direct Stability style transfer without adding a model configuration row.
